author: The Infographics Show
description:
Microsoft thought they owned the future of AI, until Sam Altman handed the keys to Amazon. Find out how OpenAI betrayed Microsoft with an insane deal that changed everything. From the secret "AGI Poison Pill" buried in legal contracts to the April 2026 Reset that deleted Microsoft’s exclusive rights, find out how OpenAI orchestrated a massive corporate coup.

Discover why the deal with Amazon Web Services and its Trainium chips is the only way OpenAI survives a $140 billion burn rate, and why the dream of a non-profit "AI for humanity" is officially dead. Here is how OpenAI backstabbed Microsoft in front of the entire world.
